This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 09-02-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Mumbai Engineering Works Pvt Ltd, with its registered office at Plot 14, MIDC Industrial Area, Bengaluru
("Party A"), and Bharat Components Pvt Ltd, with its registered office at Plot 14, MIDC Industrial Area, Mumbai ("Party
B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Signatures

Party B      Bharat Components Pvt Ltd / Priya Sharma
